The '''Public Order Act 96.76''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] law. Posting a private [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] without informing the [[Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations]] was in violation of this law.
